name: Kiosk Direct - Auto Refund
description: A walk-up sale at the machine itself. The machine may retry a jammed dispense as often as it can; whatever never comes out is refunded without asking, because there is no identified customer to ask.

name: Kiosk Direct - Customer Controlled
description: A sale at the machine by an identified customer. Nothing is refunded automatically: the entitlement is kept so the customer may try another machine or ask for their money back.

name: Kiosk Pickup - Customer Selected
description: An order raised away from the machine and collected at a kiosk the customer chose. The target cannot be inferred from where the order was created, so one must be named before it is confirmed.
